lines.en: I walk to the drumbeat of a raid.

lines.zh: 袍角拖过泥地，沾了药渍。
lines.en: My robe drags through the mud, picking up potion stains.

lines.zh: 我一步一步数着村庄的门。
lines.en: I count the village doors, one step at a time.
Get out of the way; I am late for breaking doors.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩碎了一只南瓜。
lines.en: My boots crush a pumpkin on the way.
The potion bottles rattle at my waist.

lines.zh: 我的步子慢，鞋跟却踩得死。
lines.en: My pace is slow, but my heels strike hard.
The torch at the village gate should go out.

lines.zh: 我绕开陷阱，这点眼力还有。
lines.en: I step around the trap; I still have some sense.

lines.zh: 灰烬从我的袖口掉出来。
lines.en: Ash falls out of my sleeve as I go.
I stop counting at the seventh house.
The chickens by the road run when they see me.

lines.zh: 我的影子比别人长一截。
lines.en: My shadow runs a little longer than other people's.
I know night roads well enough to walk them blind.

lines.zh: 我踩过菜地，白菜都趴下了。
lines.en: I cross the garden, and the cabbages flatten.

lines.zh: 我的影子扫过村口的井。
lines.en: My shadow slides over the village well.

lines.zh: 我把药水晃了晃，看颜色。
lines.en: I swirl the potion and watch its colour.
This bottle still needs a pinch of glowstone dust.
I lick my teeth and smile to myself.
The cauldron is dry, so I will rest a while.

lines.zh: 袭击什么时候开始？我等烦了。
lines.en: When does the raid start? I am tired of waiting.
I set the sugar and redstone apart from each other.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子很灵，闻得出胆小鬼。
lines.en: My nose is sharp; I can smell a coward.
The bone shards poke my hand in the pocket.

lines.zh: 我用指甲刮掉瓶口的渣。
lines.en: I scrape the residue off the bottle's rim.
This village is far too quiet for my taste.

lines.zh: 我数着还剩几瓶滞留药水。
lines.en: I count how many lingering potions I have left.

lines.zh: 火光照得我的脸更难看。
lines.en: Firelight makes my face look even worse.
I am deciding which house to burn first.

lines.zh: 别站在我背后，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Do not stand behind me; I do not like it.
I scrape the residue from the pot.
Tonight's brew is one ingredient short.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，刚打过铁？
lines.en: You smell of iron; been at the anvil?

lines.zh: 你这副五官，我记进了账本。
lines.en: Those features of yours are going in my ledger.

lines.zh: 空着手来？我最喜欢这种。
lines.en: Empty-handed? That is my favourite kind of visitor.

lines.zh: 我一抬手，眼睛就跟不上。
lines.en: When my hand lifts, your eyes cannot follow.

lines.zh: 二十六点血，够我陪你玩。
lines.en: Twenty-six points of health; enough to play with you.
Your armour will not stop a potion.

lines.zh: 我在看你的靴子，跑不跑得动。
lines.en: I am studying your boots, judging how fast they run.
You are on the villagers' side, are you not?
Do not be frightened when I smile.

lines.zh: 你这双眼睛，我见过很多次。
lines.en: I have seen eyes like yours many times.
I have moved the bottle to my left hand.

lines.zh: 退到墙角，也只是晚一点。
lines.en: Back into the corner, and you only delay it.
Do you know how hard I am to kill?

lines.zh: 二十六点血，才掉这么点。
lines.en: Twenty-six points, and that barely took any.
That cut went straight through my purple robe.

lines.zh: 我按住肋骨，把叫声咽回去。
lines.en: I clamp my ribs and swallow the sound.
Blood runs down, mixed with potion.
I will return that sword stroke to you.

lines.zh: 疼得清楚，说明我还没散。
lines.en: The pain is sharp, so I have not come apart.
I retreat behind the cauldron.
Do you dare come one step closer?
My fingers are trembling now.
Redstone? Put it down; that is mine.
You have glowstone dust in that hand.
Sugar will do as well; I am not picky.
I can smell the gunpowder from here.
Give me the lapis and stop dawdling.

lines.zh: 你把材料摊开让我看看。
lines.en: Lay the ingredients out so I can look.
This is enough for three potions.
I lean in; I only want the recipe.
Do not hold that bottle so high.

lines.zh: 我要的不是你的命，是材料。
lines.en: It is not your life I want; it is the materials.
Bone shards will do in a pinch.

lines.zh: 你把背包打开，我自己挑。
lines.en: Open your pack; I will choose for myself.
My hand is out; do not pull yours back.
A trade? I would rather just take it.
That rattle in your pocket is sugar, yes?

lines.zh: 把玻璃瓶给我，空的那种。
lines.en: Hand me the glass bottle, the empty one.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你身上会沾药。
lines.en: Bump me and you will get potion on your clothes.
Do not touch my robe.
I am sturdier than I look.
You knock into me and the bottle spills.
Move aside; I do not go around people.
My bones are sharp against your shoulder.
That counts as your bad luck.

lines.zh: 我不推人，我只是走过去。
lines.en: I do not shove; I simply walk through.
The potion is smoking on your sleeve.
The collision startles the crows above.
We are not mates; we are accomplices.
She wears purple too, with dirtier cuffs.
We split the potions, half each.

lines.zh: 两个女巫站一起，天都暗了。
lines.en: Two witches together and the sky darkens.
She brews; I handle the door-breaking.

lines.zh: 我们不拥抱，只碰一下瓶口。
lines.en: We do not embrace; we clink bottle necks.
She always takes one extra bottle when we split.
Our laughter is enough to scare off sheep.
She watches the rear for me.
The coven scattered, but the cauldron is still warm.
That bottle on the ground is mine now.
I bend down and pick up a piece of redstone.
Do not pick that up; it is my ingredient.
My fingers are thin and quick at picking things up.
I will take this whole pile of bone shards.
Drops belong to whoever gets there first.
I slip the sugar into my sleeve.
Whatever you dropped, I am confiscating.
My pockets will not hold any more.
I will leave once I have gathered these.

lines.zh: 你踏进村子，我就知道了。
lines.en: You stepped into the village, and I knew.
The one with the sword goes first.
I smell the oil on that iron golem.
Someone has sounded the horn.
You shield the villagers. How amusing.
I lift a finger and point at you.
The target is set; do not change it.

lines.zh: 你在门后，我看得见影子。
lines.en: You are behind the door; I see your shadow.
I will note this household first.

lines.zh: 别以为躲在草垛里就行。
lines.en: Do not think a haystack will hide you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，药水已经在手里。
lines.en: I raise my hand with the potion already in it.

lines.zh: 你侧身，我的瓶口也跟着转。
lines.en: You shift sideways, and my bottle follows the turn.

lines.zh: 落点我早看好了，在你脚边。
lines.en: I picked the landing spot already: right at your feet.
Stop running; a broken bottle is such a nuisance.
I do not chase; I only need a good throw.
Hiding behind that wall will not save you.
My fingers are on the bottle's cork.
The wind is blowing in your direction.
I smile once, and you start to panic.
Three seconds; I will count them for you.

lines.zh: 我把滞留药水砸在你脚下。
lines.en: I smash a lingering potion at your feet.
A purple cloud rises from the ground.
Do not breathe in; it is too late.
I step back while the cloud keeps spreading.
This is not a blade; it is medicine at its worst.
Your legs must be going weak by now.
I reach and pull out another bottle.
Cough for me; it is a lovely sound.
I walk through my own spilled potion.
The next bottle will be stronger.

lines.zh: 袭击的号角一响，我就来。
lines.en: When the raid horn sounds, I arrive.
I walk out of the smoke.
This village has a guest tonight.
Set up the cauldron first; the people come later.
I shake the ash out of my sleeve.
The purple robe is new; do not dirty it.
I stood at the village gate for a while.
Someone is watching me through a window.
It is dark now, which is convenient.

lines.zh: 我笑出了声，惊飞一只鸟。
lines.en: I laugh out loud and startle a bird.

lines.zh: 袍子烧起来了，我拍了两下。
lines.en: My robe catches fire; I slap at it.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶滑下来，摔得够呛。
lines.en: I slide off the roof and land badly.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，药味都没了。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth and washes out the potion taste.
The blast tips over my cauldron.
An arrow pins my shoulder. A good shot.

lines.zh: 紫色的光捆住我的手腕。
lines.en: Purple light binds my wrists together.

lines.zh: 我忘了吃东西，只顾着熬药。
lines.en: I forgot to eat; I was busy brewing.

lines.zh: 雷打中我的瓶子，全碎了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my bottles and shatters them all.

lines.zh: 我掉进黑暗，锅也一起掉了。
lines.en: I fall into the dark, cauldron and all.
